title: Bob's Balloons

services.name: Sunrise Balloon Flight
services.desc: Duration 3 hours total, 1 hour flight. About We usually fly from the treetops to 1000 feet. At treetop level we frequently spot deer and other wildlife, and also talk to people down below. It's always interesting to see them look around for the voices from above. faq.a: A. We generally launch at daybreak to avoid mid-day thermals, but we can occasionally do late afternoon flights, particularly in the winter. We fly 365 days a year in Central Florida, weather permitting. Where do you fly? We have hundreds of takeoff and landing sites in Central Florida.
